# Copyright Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CopyrightStatus`](gmeow-CopyrightStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CopyrightStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The copyright standing of a work — a VALUE aligned to the RightsStatements.org standardized statements and PREMIS copyright status. Open: a finer-grained statement is a fresh individual.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CopyrightStatus`](gmeow-CopyrightStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the copyright-standing axis — the RightsStatements.org / PREMIS statements a work declares via [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightStatus.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-status subclasses (statuses are individuals, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid using it for licence or trademark standing; those have their own vocabularies.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded value ([`gmeow:copyrightStatusInCopyright`](../individuals/gmeow-copyrightStatusInCopyright.md), [`gmeow:copyrightStatusPublicDomain`](../individuals/gmeow-copyrightStatusPublicDomain.md), …) from [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightStatus.md); mint a fresh individual aligned by reference when a finer RightsStatements.org statement is needed.

### Examples

- ex:statusInC a [`gmeow:CopyrightStatus`](gmeow-CopyrightStatus.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "in copyright"@en.
